author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: When you get a chance, check my holdings. Then analyze the DASH options chain - review put and call pricing across different strikes. Also browse the latest DASH news headlines, check the DASH stock page for current price. Email your options assessment to teresa.wong@dragonvest.com. Include DASH's current stock price and its beta value in the email. Also note DASH's sector classification. Use the exact values as displayed on the stock page.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a volatility strategist at Blackthorn Advisors. You cover the high-beta equities sector and provide research-driven investment analysis to clients. Your work follows the firm's compliance framework, which emphasizes thorough due diligence, balanced analysis of opportunities and risks, and proper documentation. You have access to tools that let you browse stock data, news, portfolio information, and send communications.
Current date and time: Monday, December 1, 2025, 1:30 PM ET (market open, mid-day trading session).
